questions.question: Which satellite-based system that was launched by the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) and Airport Authority of India (AAI) in October 2019 will alert deep-sea fishermen of upcoming disasters?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**GEMINI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GEMINI **satellite-based system that was launched by the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) and Airport Authority of India (AAI) in October 2019 will alert deep-sea fishermen of upcoming disasters
 
• The full form of GEMINI is Gagan Enabled Mariner's Instrument for Navigation and Information.
 
• GEMINI System which was launched recently in India aims to alert deep-sea fishermen of upcoming disasters.
 
• The GEMINI Device was launched by the Union Minister of Earth Sciences Dr Harsh Vardhan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The device is developed for effective dissemination of emergency information and communication on Ocean States Forecast and mapping of Potential Fishing Zones (PFZ) to fishermen.
 
• The accurate state of the ocean which includes the forecasts related to winds, waves, ocean currents, water temperature, etc is provided by the Ocean States Forecast.
 
• The information about the probable locations of fish aggregation in the seas to the fishermen is provided by the Potential Fishing Zones (PFZ).
 
• The GEMINI is the portable receiver that is linked to ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) satellites.
 
• With this device fishermen outside the signal range of their phone companies, i.e 10-12 Kilometers can access warnings and alerts.
 
• The device can send the signals up to three hundred nautical miles.
 
• While developing the GEMINI device the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) in collaboration with the Airports Authority of India (AAI) utilized the GAGAN (GPS Aided Geo Augmented Navigation).

questions.question: How much time does a computer built by Google take to perform a computation making it the fastest computer to reach quantum supremacy?
questions.solution:

• It is a device so powerful that it could do in four minutes what it would take a traditional supercomputer **10,000 years to accomplish.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• What is Quantum Supremacy?

 
 
• It is a term proposed in 2012 by John Preskill, professor of theoretical physics at the California Institute of Technology. 
 
• It describes the point where quantum computers can do things that classical computers cannot. 
 
• Superposition and entanglement are what give quantum computers the ability to process so much more information so much faster.

questions.question: Which of the following is the name of the NASA programme to land first woman and next man on the Moon by 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Artemis.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Artemis is an ongoing space mission run by NASA with the goal of landing the first female astronaut and next male astronaut on the Moon's South Pole by 2024.**
 
• It is the US space agency's first crewed Moon mission since Apollo 17 in 1972.
 
• NASA is working on the Artemis program that aims to land humans on the moon by 2024.
 
• It has put forward a plan showing what a US lunar presence may look like after the milestone.
 
• NASA submitted a 13-page report to the National Space Council.
 
• The report titled NASA's Plan for Sustained Lunar Exploration and Development offers a summary of what NASA will accomplish the 2024 moon landing mission.
 
• NASA's VIPER would land near the western edge of the Nobile Crater at the Moon's South Pole, one of the coldest areas in the solar system, VIPER stands for Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover.
 
• The robotic rover would be delivered to the Moon's surface in late 2023 under the Artemis program and part of the NASA agency's Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Orion:**

 
 
• It is one of the brightest constellations and the best-known constellations in the night sky.
 
• It lies on the celestial equator.
 
• Orion has been known since ancient times.
 
• The constellation is also known as the Hunter, as it is associated with one in Greek mythology.
 
• It represents the mythical hunter Orion, who is often depicted in star maps as facing the charge of Taurus, the bull.
 
 
 
• **Apollo 11:**
 
 
• It was the first spaceflight to land humans on the Moon, and Neil Armstrong was the first man on the Moon. On 20 July 1969, at 20:18 UTC, Americans Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed.
 
• Six hours later, on 21 July, Armstrong walked onto the lunar surface, and Aldrin followed him next.
 
• Mission Objectives: Apollo 11 Moon Landing's primary objective was to fulfill a national target set by President John F. Kennedy on May 25, 1961: to perform a crewed lunar landing and return to Earth.

questions.question: Which instrument was used to detect gravitational waves for the very first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**LIGO**__.

__
 
• **LIGO was used to detect gravitational waves for the very first time**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• LIGO is **Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory.**

 
 
• It is located in** Richland, Washington.**
 
• **In 2015**, scientists detected gravitational waves for the very first time.
 
 
 
• A gravitational wave is an **invisible ripple in space.**
 
• These first gravitational waves occurred when **two black holes crashed into one another.**
 
• The collision took place 1.3 billion years ago. But, the ripples didn’t make it to Earth until 2015.
 
• **Causes of a gravitational wave are:**
 
 
• When a star explodes asymmetrically.
 
• When two big stars orbit each other.
 
• When two black holes orbit each other and merge.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a global positioning system ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Buvik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Global Positioning System:**

 
 
• The satellite network system used to determine the exact geographical locations to be used by **military or civil users** is called GPS. 
 
• It was first used by the** US military in the year 1960**.
 
• GPS is a system and it is made up of three parts:** satellites, ground stations, and receivers**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Galileo -** It is a GPS established by the European Union through the European space agency in 2016, operated by the** European GNSS** (Global Navigation Satellite System) agency, headquartered in Prague, Czech Republic. 
 
• **BeiDou -** BeiDou is a **Chinese navigation system **that has two separate constellations first launched in **October 2000**. currently, it has **35** total satellites.
 
• **GLONASS** **(****Globalnaya Navigazionnaya Sputnikovaya Sistema)** is the Russian version of GPS whose development started in **1976** by the Soviet Union now managed by the Russian Federal Space Agency. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e549cb45ac78aca065082aa5a940b1d6506603cfff2fd1300a22049ad93dc6.png] 

 
• Buvik (Bureau of Naviks) is the human resource management institution for the enrolled personnel of the Indian coast guard formed in 1981. **​**__
